Courtside Mesh Jersey only: deep forest green basketball mesh sleeveless jersey, burgundy polygon-pattern number 72 with thin ivory outline on front AND back, small ivory winged V at front high chest and back nape, ivory side panels with burgundy/ivory piping, striped rib bindings at neck and armholes, short side hem splits.
